title_original: Democrat Lawmaker Vows to Investigate Trump's Smithsonian Plan
excerpt_original: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch defended the institution's independence on the same day, a month before he's scheduled to step down from his post.

blocks.text: Democratic Representative Chellie Pingree of Maine has vowed to investigate the Trump administration's leaked overhaul plan of the Smithsonian Institution, in a letter sent to the Smithsonian's Board of Regents yesterday, November 24.

This week, photos a commuter took of a Trump staffer's laptop screen showing the so-called " Smithsonian Institution Renewal Plan " were dispatched to ProPublica . The document included planned reviews of the institution's exhibition and funding strategies, new exhibitions on American nationalism, and revamped institution-wide guidelines.
If instituted, the 25 measures outlined in the plan could upend the Smithsonian's autonomous operations across its network of 21 museums, research centers, and the National Zoo.
